items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: Tillman told me they was gonna have a parade.

ctx.x: What color is it? I thought I should do.

What color is it? I got two man. I got with a yellow back on it. And then I got another book. And then I got another book. Right there. Oh man, I thought that you should. I'll bring them out on Sunday. You gonna be there Sunday? Yeah, I'll be there Sunday. Yeah. Tillman told me they was gonna have a parade.
